declaration: This rule is an audit diagnostic declaration for reproducible coverage calculation. It is NOT the historical real consumer and MUST NOT be used as evidence of actual availability rate.

coverage_definition.numerator: union of associated timestamps expanded by fixed windows
coverage_definition.denominator: complete GT valid support duration (union of valid segments)

missing_handling.gt_gap: exclude gap duration from both numerator and denominator

historical_consumer_difference.note: These two are not equivalent; this audit rule is a third distinct definition declared for reproducibility only
